overview.atmosphere: Small Vosges ski area on the Markstein pass. 20km pistes. Cross-country skiing, snowkiting, tobogganing, snowshoeing. Forested, quiet, family-friendly. Near Oderen in the Saint-Amarin valley.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Cross-country skiing network, snowkiting, tobogganing, snowshoeing, winter hiking, mountain biking (summer)
